findings.one_line: The headline now proves only an order-one shared cross-pair upper bound on ℛ_pair, while the proposed two-branch same-sample Möbius-HOIF/multiresolution construction and its all-smoothness frontier remain expressly unresolved in oeq:multiresolution-order-frontier.

Positioning treats KBRW and a few adjacent close-pair/HOIF sources, but gives no relevance sentence or theorem-level comparison for several bibliography entries (including Kennedy 2023, Nie--Wager 2021, Robins et al. 2008/2017, Calonico et al. 2022, Athey--Wager 2021, and Chernozhukov et al. 2021); complete or remove these citations and state the closest-result comparison after the main theorem.
